    function utir_scrollTimeUpdate() {

            if(!utir_scrolling){
                let updateScroll = utir_audio.currentTime * (1000 / utir_audio.duration);
                utir_scrollSlider.value = updateScroll;
            }
            var currentMins = Math.floor(utir_audio.currentTime / 60);
            var currentSecs = Math.floor(utir_audio.currentTime - currentMins * 60);
            var durationMins = Math.floor(utir_audio.duration / 60);
            var durationSecs = Math.floor(utir_audio.duration - durationMins * 60);
            if (currentSecs < 10) {
                currentSecs = "0" + currentSecs;
            }
            if (currentMins < 10) {
                currentMins = "0" + currentMins;
            }
            if (durationSecs < 10) {
                durationSecs = "0" + durationSecs;
            }
            utir_currentTimeText.innerHTML = currentMins + ":" + currentSecs;
        } else {
            utir_currentTimeText.innerHTML = "00" + ":" + "00";
